Issue #5: Deprecated Set Suite Variable keyword
Location: Line 233 in gui/gui_test/security_and_access_menu/test_policies_sub_menu.robot
Issue: Set Suite Variable is deprecated since Robot Framework 7.0, use VAR with scope=SUITE instead 

Fix: Replace with modern VAR syntax
```
# Current (deprecated)
${initial_basic_auth_setting}=  Get Text  ${xpath_basic_authentication_toggle}
Set Suite Variable  ${initial_basic_auth_setting}
```

# Modern syntax
```
${initial_basic_auth_setting}=  Get Text  ${xpath_basic_authentication_toggle}
VAR  ${initial_basic_auth_setting}  ${initial_basic_auth_setting}  scope=SUITE
```

Issue #6: Typo in parameter documentation
Location: Line 371 in gui/gui_test/security_and_access_menu/test_policies_sub_menu.robot
Issue: Documentation comment has typo: "Intial" should be "Initial"
Fix: Correct the spelling
```
# initial_option_value         Initial policy option value.
```

Issue #9: Inconsistent quoting style in IF statements
Location: Lines 373, 397 in gui/gui_test/security_and_access_menu/test_policies_sub_menu.robot
Issue: IF statements use single quotes for string comparisons. Robot Framework best practices suggest double quotes.
Fix: Use consistent quoting
```
IF  "${initial_option_value}" == "Enabled"
```

Using ${initial_option_value}" == "Enabled" will throw error as the value is reference before assignment. Using robot suggested method '$initial_option_value' == 'Enabled'

```
Variables in the original expression "'${initial_option_value}' == 'Enabled'" were resolved before the expression was evaluated. Try using "$initial_option_value == 'Enabled'" syntax to avoid that. See Evaluating Expressions appendix in Robot Framework User Guide for more details.

```

ssue #1: Missing error handling for Redfish.Patch operation
Location: Line 404 in gui/gui_test/security_and_access_menu/test_policies_sub_menu.robot

Issue: The Redfish.Patch operation in teardown has no error handling. If it fails, the system may be left in an inconsistent state with no indication of the failure.

Fix: Add error handling and status code validation
```
TRY
    Redfish.Patch  ${REDFISH_BASE_URI}AccountService
    ...  body={"HTTPBasicAuth":${basic_auth_state}}
    ...  valid_status_codes=[${HTTP_OK}]
EXCEPT  AS  ${error}
    Log  Failed to restore Basic Auth state: ${error}  level=WARN
END
```

Why: Teardown failures should be logged but not cause test failures. Silent failures make debugging difficult.
